fix_and_optimize.answer:
from collections import deque
tasks = deque(["email", "report", "meeting"])
while tasks:
    task = tasks.popleft()
    print("Processing:", task)
fix_and_optimize.explanation: deque.popleft() is O(1) vs list.pop(0) O(n).
